comment: Business-card pages are handed out verbally and printed, so they get extensionless URLs: /card/mothae-namane serves card/mothae-namane.html. Scoped to /card/ on purpose — site-wide cleanUrls would 308-redirect every existing .html link, and all of this site's internal links use the extension. Vercel checks the filesystem before applying rewrites, so /card/mothae-namane.html keeps working directly and does not fall through to this rule.
